digital_twins.title: Digital twin · room
digital_twins.description: Spatial model reconstructed from LiDAR and video.
digital_twins.canvas: Interactive room model. Elements can also be selected from the list.
digital_twins.errorHelp: Check your connection, permissions and browser WebGL support.
digital_twins.help: Drag to orbit. Right-drag to pan; scroll to zoom. Click an element or select it from the list.
digital_twins.provenance: LiDAR + video · 318 control points. Geometric model without sensor integration. Scale has not been independently verified. Chairs and some furnishings have approximate positions. Dimensions refer to the model.
digital_twins.selectHelp: Click the model or choose an element from the list.
